info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Insurance Claims Claims Status-v3-spec
info.description: This API provides access to the status of insurance claims, enabling users to retrieve real-time information on claim processing. Developers can utilize this resource to check the status of individual or batch claims efficiently. It is particularly useful for insurance providers and agents who need to monitor claims and manage client communications. The endpoint facilitates streamlined operations in insurance claim management by offering timely updates on claim status.

get.description: This endpoint allows developers to fetch the current status of claims, providing essential information regarding their processing stages and outcomes.
